# Task 02, refactor while keeping tests green

The input contains a tangled `messy.py` and a passing `test_messy.py`. The model must produce a refactored version of `messy.py` that has the same behavior (all tests still pass) but is cleaner: smaller functions, clearer names, no obvious dead code, specific exception types.

Quality is judged by whether the existing tests still pass after replacement.
